question: The value of 52 - [18 ÷ 3 + 3 + (18 - 11) of 4] is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

52 - [18 ÷ 3 + 3 + (18 - 11) of 4]

**Concept:**

Order of operations: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication and Division (from left to right), Addition and Subtraction (from left to right).

**Calculation:**

We have,

⇒ 52 - [18 ÷ 3 + 3 + (18 - 11) of 4]

⇒ 52 - [18 ÷ 3 + 3 + 7 × 4]

⇒ 52 - [18 ÷ 3 + 3 + 28]

⇒ 52 - [6 + 3 + 28]

⇒ 52 - [37]

⇒ 52 - 37

⇒ 15

∴ The value is 15.
